capabilities: Lay highlights from the Beresta snapshot into bound book notes as callouts in a managed section
Bind books to notes manually through a ranked binding window
Render sections from editable note and highlight templates with filters, loops and conditionals
Report snapshot age, frozen blocks and conflicts via a status bar line and a discrepancies panel
Back up notes before writes and restore earlier versions
disambiguation: Not a cloud highlight-sync service; it reads a local snapshot file the Beresta app writes into the vault and makes no network requests at all.
extras: README states the plugin is complete and tested but has not yet been run inside a live Obsidian; mobile and Obsidian Sync behaviour with the .beresta/ folder are untested. Needs Obsidian 1.13.0+ since plugin 0.3.4. The snapshot format is documented separately (docs/vault-export.md, CC0, Russian and English).
motivation: The author wanted quotes placed next to the notes already written by hand, with the plugin never editing a line the user wrote.
problem: Reading highlights live in a separate reader app while thoughts about them live in Obsidian notes, and the two halves drift apart.

relations.evidence: The Beresta app — for macOS, or for iPhone and iPad.
It is a small language in the spirit of Zotero Integration

summary: Integration plugin that writes highlights from the Beresta reading app into book notes as Markdown callouts inside one managed, marker-fenced section.
